search_scope: Focused PubMed/PMC, official journal, ClinicalTrials.gov and source-page review; PubMed candidate-scoped retrieval snapshots archived separately; not a systematic review.
modeling_policy: Do not convert mixed, non-ER-positive, class-level, or evidence-gap records into direct ER-positive drug-disease graph relations; preserve reviewed records as qualified DiseaseEvidence nodes linked to Drug and Disease.
limitations: Evidence absence in this focused search is not evidence that no study exists.
Preclinical models, mixed-subtype trials, and target pharmacology are kept distinct from ER-positive clinical efficacy.
DiseaseEvidence links record reviewed context and do not assert treatment effect or clinical efficacy.
